summary: `docs/` can be published as one deterministic `docs.tar.zst` plus a per-file `manifest.json` (`pnpm docs:bundle`), and `lib/docs/tree.ts` reads either the checkout or that verified archive behind a new `DOCS_SOURCE` switch.
reader_impact: Nobody sees a different screen yet: `DOCS_SOURCE` unset reads `docs/` from the checkout exactly as before, so `/admin/docs*` and every docs-backed page render unchanged; the archive and its CI artifact are what a deployment opts into.
